shots.caption: Title: New World Computing presents Might and Magic; ESC starts, SPACE scenes
Title, second picture: Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum
Demo scene (SPACE on the title): a warrior's stronghold or a wizard's lair
Demo scene: an iron box opens, each share worth 38 gold, 10 gems found
After ESC on the title: are you ready? Then press Enter!
Options: create new characters, view all characters, go to town
Create new characters: seven statistics rolled, eligible classes, ENT to re-roll
Creation: Knight chosen, select a race: Human, Elf, Dwarf, Gnome, Half-Orc
Creation: select alignment (Good, Neut, Evil)
Creation: Knight, Human, Good, Male, name RYZ typed
Creation: SAVE CHARACTER (Y/N)?
View all characters: letter, name, town, level and class of the seven listed
Roster profile: new Knight RYZ with a Club; Ctrl-N re-name, Ctrl-D delete
Re-naming a character: NAME prompt under CONDI's profile
First control: in the Inn of Sorpigal facing its door; commands, party of six
Sorpigal: sign above the door reads THE INN OF SORPIGAL
The innkeeper asks: would you like to sign in (Y/N)?
Signed in: Inn of Sorpigal, available characters, party marked with @
B and B Blacksmiths: a man wearing a leather apron speaks
Blacksmith: buy weapons, buy armor, buy misc, sell item; RYZ's gold
Blacksmith weapons: Dagger 5 ... Crossbow 50, Staff 30
Blacksmith armor: Small Shield 10 ... Chain Mail 200
Blacksmith misc: Torch 2, Rope & Hooks, Garlic, Magic Herbs, Scroll of Fire 300
Blacksmith, sell item: Club worth 0, the Short Sword bought for 20 sells for 10
Blacksmith with MNZ the Sorcerer shopping: weapons marked - cannot be used
RYZ's profile: statistics, HP, AC, gold, Short Sword and Leather Armor equipped
RYZ's profile: equip which item A-F?
Share all: gems, gold or food split evenly among the party
Share gold: the party's 1833 gold split evenly, RYZ now holds 305
Gather all: gems, gold or food onto CONDI
Gather gold: CONDI now carries the party's 1833 gold
Trade: trade with which character 1-6?
Trade which: gems, gold, food or an item
Trade gold: how much? 250 typed
After the trade: CONDI's profile shows 250 gold
Trade item: RYZ's Club is now in CONDI's backpack
Trade food: EBO received 4 food from RYZ and holds 22
Discard which item A-F?
Discarded: the Club is gone from RYZ's backpack
Use which item A-F or 1-6?
Using the Short Sword: no special power
RYZ drank a Might Potion bought at the blacksmith: Might 15 to 20
Using Magic Herbs: cast on which character 1-6?
Magic Herbs used on RYZ: hit points 6 to 14
Remove which item 1-6?
Leather Armor removed into the backpack: armor class drops
MNZ the Sorcerer tries to equip Chain Mail: wrong class
Quick reference: hit points, spell points, AC, food and condition of all six
Order: re-order the party by typing the old positions in the new order
Order typed 2 1 3 6 5 4: CONDI now leads, MNZ and CUBI swapped
Casting from a profile: MNZ enters level 1, number 5 (Leather Skin), then Enter
DEDDO the Cleric casts First Aid (1-4): cast on which character?
First Aid cast on RYZ: done, DEDDO has 4 of 5 spell points left
RYZ after First Aid: hit points 6 to 14 of 15
Detect Magic (Sorcerer 1-2): Magic Herbs and Might Potion are magic, 3 charges
MNZ at level 7: 38 spell points, spell level 4, 14 gems
Create Food (Cleric 3-1): 3 spell points and a gem, DEDDO's food 18 to 24
Jump (Sorcerer 2-4) in a town corridor: spell failed
Protect: spells currently active, Leather Skin
Protect: Protection from Fear +21%, Light (1) and Leather Skin active
Location (Sorcerer 1-7): in town, map sector C-2, coordinates and facing
Rest here (Y/N)?
Rest complete: no encounters!
Sorpigal: a locked door (LOCKED!)
Unlock: who will try 1-6?
Unlock: CUBI the Robber picks the lock, success!
Unlock tried by RYZ the Knight: razor sharp blades slice through the party
Quick reference after the blade trap: every member lost hit points
Bash on the locked door: a faint hiss, noxious fumes fill the air (gas trap)
Behind the bashed door: two Rabid Jackals and three Vampire Bats
Encounter: four Poltergeists, picture, Attack / Bribe / Retreat / Surrender
Combat round 1: formation, monster list, handicap, a Poltergeist hacks at CONDI
Encounter option Bribe: no response
Encounter option Surrender: the monsters don't take prisoners!
Sorpigal, the same room at another moment: five Goblins
Sorpigal, the same room: two Guardsmen and three Gnomes
Bribe accepted for talks: give up all your food (Y/N)?
Bribe paid
Quick reference after the bribe
Combat: options for MNZ the Sorcerer (Exchange, Retreat, Cast, Use, Block)
Combat: MNZ casts spell level 1, number 4 (Flame Arrow)
MNZ casts a spell: Poltergeist takes 5 points of damage
EBO shoots a Poltergeist with the sling: hit for 7 points, Poltergeist goes down
Combat order Fight: RYZ chooses which monster in reach, A-C
Combat order Exchange: MNZ, exchange places with (1-6)?
After Exchange: MNZ stands in position 1, RYZ in position 6
Combat order Use: MNZ's items, use which?
DEDDO casts Bless (Cleric 1-2) in combat: done
MNZ casts Sleep (Sorcerer 1-8) at a Poltergeist: not affected

Sleep (Sorcerer 1-8) on five Goblins: two not affected, one marked (ASLEEP)
Identify Monster (Sorcerer 2-3): a Poltergeist's hit points, AC, speed, attacks
Lightning Bolt (Sorcerer 3-4), MNZ at level 7: 30 points, Poltergeist goes down
Fire Ball (Sorcerer 3-1) at hand-to-hand range: CONDI takes 18 points of damage
Victory: for defeating the monsters each survivor receives 100 experience points
Searching the room after the fight: nothing
After a fight: CONDI at 0 hit points, condition unconscious
Quick reference: poisoned, dead, asleep, paralyzed, stone, blinded
A party at 1 hit point each: MNZ goes down, the last of the six
The shadow of death has fallen upon your party: renew the quest from the inn
Otto's Training: training for level 2 costs 25 gold
Training without the 25 gold: not enough gold
Congratulations! You are now level 2, you gained 11 hit points
Training done: level 3 needs 1315 more experience points
Training at level 7 with 61480 experience: level 8 needs 34520 more
RYZ after training: level 2, age 19, 26 hit points, 1808 gold left
Temple Moonshadow: restore health, uncurse items, restore align, make donation
Temple with RYZ at 4 hit points: restore health costs 25 gold
Health restored: 25 gold paid, nothing left to restore
RYZ after the temple
Temple Moonshadow with RYZ poisoned: a star marks him, the clerics offer help
Temple with CONDI dead: the price of raising
Donation made: 100 gold paid
Eulards Fine Foods: all you can eat, 5 gold each, will you pay?
Eulards Fine Foods after paying: thank you, come again!
Quick reference after the meal
Ye Olde Hogge Tavern: have a drink, tip bartender, listen for rumors
Tavern: a drink costs 1 gold
Tavern rumor after two tips: the desert has many oases!
A statue's inscription: in memory of a time long ago...
Statue of a half-orc archer: in honor of Corak, for his mapping expedition
Statue of a human cleric: in honor of Gala and the savages of the volcanic isles
Statue of a human knight: five towns you must travel
Statue of a gray minotaur: this beast rules a fortress in the Enchanted Forest
Statue of an elven wizard: seek the wizard Ranalou at the Korin Bluffs
Statue of a gnome robber: one by water, one by land, one by air and one by sand
Statue of a dwarf paladin: there are many dungeons like me, the idols will help
A stone statue with a plaque: search it?
A tenacious leprechaun offers travel to a town for one gem
The leprechaun took one gem: the party stands in Algary
Sorpigal (5,8): trap door!
After the trap door, with Light cast: the cavern below Sorpigal (CAVE1) at (5,8)
Sorpigal: stairs going down, take them (Y/N)?
Below Sorpigal without light: DARKNESS
Cavern below Sorpigal after MNZ cast Light: green rock, a portcullis and a door
Cavern below Sorpigal: an elderly man behind a desk needs a courier service
Cavern: scrawled on the wall, a message reads: the jail above has many cells
Cavern, the Arena: balconies of cheering peasants, will you participate?
The Arena below Sorpigal: the party agrees to participate
Cavern: a shimmering blue and white portal appears, enter?
Cavern encounter: five Skeletons
Cavern encounter: five Fire Ants
Cavern encounter: ten Snakes
Outside Sorpigal: mountains and forest
Sector C-2, forest: a glowing white column, touch it?
Sector C-2, dense woods: a strange fountain, drink?
Sector C-2: statues block the path, smash them?
Wilderness encounter in the forest: nine Strangling Vines
Sector C-2: a toothless gypsy seer offers to read a character's sign
Sector C-2, mountains: there's a cave here, enter?
Sector A-1: the Dark Rider and his men surround the party, a duel is offered
Sector A-1: the duel with the Dark Rider is accepted
Sector A-1: carved on a block of ice, start at 15-7 and walk to Doom
Sector A-1: the fabled Castle Doom, will you enter?
Sector E-1, south edge: mountains beside a red expanse
Sector E-1, mountains: ruins of Castle Dragadune, enter?
Portsmith: a sign above the door reads Inn of Portsmith

Portsmith, B. Smith's Workshop: a young girl forging a long sword
B. Smith's Workshop, Portsmith, weapons: Spear 15 to Glaive and Bardiche 80
B. Smith's Workshop, Portsmith: armor for sale
B. Smith's Workshop, Portsmith, misc: 10 Foot Pole to Antidote Brew 500
Portsmith: Zam, astral brother of Zom: you're not the couriers!
Portsmith: a female voice from an intoxicating mist; the men are marked
The Inn of Algary: a tall bearded half-orc behind a large desk
Algary: Morango the Mystic asks whom to measure
Algary: a magic portal, enter?
The Inn of Dusk: an eerie silence, a ghostly apparition asks to sign in
Dusk, Clearman's Training: several empty suits of armor approach
Dusk: a gold chest: open it, find/remove trap, detect magic/trap
Gold chest, open it: who will try 1-6?
The chest opens for CUBI the Robber: 200 gems and an Undead Amulet found
Find/remove trap fails on the gold chest: razor sharp blades slice the party
Gold chest, detect magic/trap tried by MNZ
Dusk encounter: ten Vampires
Dusk encounter: ten Banshees

Erliquin: three huge armor clad knights bark in unison, want a good workout?
Castle Alamar: castle guards exclaim, no merchants pass! Begone peasants
Castle Alamar: a fair maiden weeps in a steel cage: set free, torment or leave
Castle Alamar, throne room: the king sends the party to the Crypt of Carmenca
Castle Doom: a golden door repels you!
Castle Doom: the true King Alamar, in a forcefield, tells of the impostor

Castle White Wolf: a banner and a button on the wall, push it?

Cavern 3: the Demon Lord with Greater, Lesser and Minor Demons
